# Classes and Camps

![summer-speed-camp-img](https://mississippispeed.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/summer-speed-camp-img-1024x1024.jpg)

#### Boys Summer Speed Camp

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| DATE: | June 23-25th, 2025 |
| LOCATION: | Madison Ridgeland Academy |
| TIME: | 1:00 – 3:30 PM |
| GENDER: | Boys |
| SPORTS: | All |
| LIMIT: | 40 Athletes |
| COST: | $135 |

A fun three day introduction to speed agility and quickness training! The program is designed by Mike Frascogna and the camp will be led by Coach Philip Short and other MSI instructors (athlete/instructor ratio will be 8:1). High speed drills and competition will teach athletes correct movement form in areas such as acceleration, top speed, lateral speed, foot quickness, jumping, change of direction, and visual acuity. Great for athletes competing in any team sport!

[Register Now](https://portal.campnetwork.com/Register/Register.php?camp_id=398473)
